evidence_units.text: Portable H03 engineering keeps source code, contracts, schemas, tests, receipts and governed durable data reproducible from Git plus explicit bootstrap steps.
Knowledge semantics remain separate from presentation so the same accepted knowledge can feed PDF and future output formats.
A bounded product proof preserves source identity, claim evidence, artifact hashes and build lineage instead of treating an LLM response as truth.
Unknown Founder time, cash cost, shared cost or revenue remains UNKNOWN or UNPROVEN and is never silently converted to zero.
H03 domain components do not write canonical Company economics directly; canonical Company Truth mutations remain behind the logical die-state-manager boundary.
Browser profiles, OAuth sessions and secrets are host-local capability state and are not product data or durable knowledge artifacts.

claims.text: A portable knowledge-product factory treats reproducibility artifacts as first-class deliverables.
Knowledge Packages are presentation-independent and should compile through a Product Blueprint and Document AST before rendering.
Every bounded product build needs explicit evidence and artifact lineage rather than model output alone.
Economic fields that have not been observed remain UNKNOWN or UNPROVEN, never inferred as zero.
H03 may author semantic economic observations but cannot bypass the single logical die-state-manager for canonical Company Truth.
Authentication and browser session material stays outside product lineage and is manually reprovisioned when hosts change.
